1913
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 19 cont.
April 25 Sylvester Landy burried. All the children were pre- sent at the services. Resigned in his sufferings and intelligent to the last his death was happy. Received daily-though blind. R.I.P.
27 Requiem by children for Syl. Landy.
May 1st Feast of Ascension - Many Com'ions.
May 4th Wm Kruppenbacher gives $100.00 for new Church.
6th Fr. Paul and Br. Emil visit Yonkers from 30th St. Church.
8th Mrs. Brigid Hare $100.00 for new Church.
May 22 Feast of Corpus Christi - many went to Holy Com.
25 Corpus Christi Procession in the garden. Every thing favorable and beautiful - about 2500 present.
May 26 Fr. Innocent from Harlem and Fr. Venantius from "Our Lady of Sorrows accompanied Fr. Paul to Yonkers, A Capuchin Missionary from the Alutian Islands. This Fr. Paul was to be celebrant at the Corpus Christi Celebration held the day before. - but was delayed. He looks much like Fr. Bonaventure Fray looked in his younger days. Humble and zealous though over six feet tall and of noble appearance he makes a good impression.
May 30th Feast of The Sacred Heart - on Decoration Day. First time, said feast of the Sacred Heart ever celebrated in May. About 800 received Holy Com.
May 31 Altar boys B. Ball Team played with the boys from Har- lem and for the 1st time lost a game.
June 26th 14 graduates among whome 3 Alt. boys A. Ahearn, and F. McCready and D. Mccarthy.
